title: Add stub modules so the project and both targets resolve every module they list
acceptance_criteria: Every module named in Codex.uproject, Codex.Target.cs and CodexEditor.Target.cs has a Source/<Module>/ folder with a .Build.cs, a Public header and a Private cpp using IMPLEMENT_MODULE.
Stub modules depend only on Core, CoreUObject, Engine and CodexCore (CodexEditor also UnrealEd); no dependency on any higher-tier Codex module.
Clean UnrealBuildTool build of the Editor and Game targets with zero warnings (NOT YET RUN: toolchain and engine are not installed).
